verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one docs line saying SES lets you control user access to email sending through AWS IAM. That implies you can create restricted credentials for an agent, but the pack gives no detail on how fine-grained the scoping is. Missing for 10: documented least-privilege policy examples (e.g., restricting to specific identities, actions or recipients), scoped SMTP credentials, short-lived or rotatable agent credentials, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
